overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no Open Meeting Law violation. It credited the Board's account that post-adjournment conversation was social and that members were resetting the room, finding no evidence of Board business.

allegations.summary: After a April 10 meeting was adjourned, board members allegedly stayed in the room talking for about eight minutes and two kept talking while walking to their cars.
allegations.key_passage: We find no evidence that the Board discussed Board business during the approximately eight minutes that its members remained in the meeting room and walked to their cars following adjournment of the April 10 meeting.
